يختلقون (form VIII)
# يَخْتَلِقُونَ (yaḵtaliqūna) /jax.ta.li.quː.na/: third-person masculine plural non-past active indicative of اِخْتَلَقَ (iḵtalaqa)
# يُخْتَلَقُونَ (yuḵtalaqūna) /jux.ta.la.quː.na/: third-person masculine plural non-past passive indicative of اِخْتَلَقَ (iḵtalaqa)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
